title: Cournot Duopoly Equilibrium From Supermodularity
body_html:
Cournot Duopoly Equilibrium From Supermodularity

Consider two firms choosing quantities $q_i\in[0,Q_i]$ with payoff $$ g_i(q_i,q_j)=q_iP_i(q_i+q_j)-C_i(q_i). $$ Assume $P_i$ and $C_i$ are $C^1$, and the marginal revenue $$ P_i+q_i\frac{\partial P_i}{\partial q_i} $$ is decreasing in $q_j$. Then the Cournot duopoly has a Cournot-Nash equilibrium.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 4.12, Exercise 4(3)] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Cournot duopoly application of supermodular game existence.
